items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well Monk would tell me about Sidney Aarland and Louie. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, he knew much better than me. Yeah. I mean sure Monk knew.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think he came up with that band from New York that time I was doing, I think. It was some band, I can't think of who it was. I can't think of it, he came to New York.
Well Monk would tell me about Sidney Aarland and Louie.
Oh yeah, he knew much better than me. Yeah. I mean sure Monk knew.
